column1: # Sarah: a human with a gun, met four times (Vault, Kalay, Tolbi, Lalivero), stronger each time.

column3:
Kalay is loud today.
Nobody here looks up.
But you did.{page_break}We met in Vault. You
remember. You had a
weaker stance back then.{end_wait}
You again. Why are you\nfollowing us?{end_wait}

I'm not following.
I'm measuring.{page_break}Show me how your friends
fight beside you. Show
me what the Djinn can do.{end_wait}

Better. You covered
each other this time.
That's what I came for.{page_break}Keep going, Isaac.
I'll find you again.{end_wait}

You walk like someone
who has never been shot
at. Stand still.{page_break}I want to see how you
fight. Nothing personal.
Come on.{end_wait}

Not bad for a first
round. You hit harder
than you look.{page_break}My name is Sarah.
Remember it. I'll be
back to check on you.{end_wait}

Tolbi. Crowds, noise,
coins. A good place to
lose track of someone.{page_break}Not you, though.
I always find you.{end_wait}
Who sent you, Sarah?\nWhat do you want?{end_wait}

Nobody sent me.
I'm just curious how
long you can last.{page_break}Guard. Wait. Choose
your moment. That's
the lesson today.{end_wait}

You waited. You
chose. Good.{page_break}One more time,
Isaac. In Lalivero.
Don't be late.{end_wait}

You came. I wasn't
sure you would.{page_break}No tricks this time.
No lessons. Just you,
me, and what's left.{end_wait}
Then tell me the truth.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

Someone who was
never finished.
Never given a name.{page_break}I took one anyway.
Sarah. And I'm done
being measured.{end_wait}

So that's how it ends.
Not with a bang. With
someone standing.{page_break}Go on. Finish what
you started, Isaac.
Someone has to.{end_wait}
